items.title: Bank of America Cut Its Fair Isaac Price Target in Half and the Stock Still Fell Below It
items.summary: Bank of America slashed its Fair Isaac price target by half, yet the stock kept falling right through it. What regulators just changed about mortgage credit scoring may have permanently altered the case for owning FICO.

items.title: Bank Stocks Slide as Money-Center Names Lead Financials Lower: Citigroup Falls 4%, Bank of America Drops 3%, JPMorgan Chase Slips
items.summary: Citigroup is getting hit harder than Bank of America despite the legal headline landing at Merrill Lynch, and the gap between the two lenders points to something beyond the settlement driving the selloff across money-center banks.

items.title: What It Actually Takes for Bank of America to Keep Raising Its Dividend
items.summary: Bank of America just raised its dividend again, but a razor-thin capital cushion separates the next raise from a payout freeze. Here is the precise mechanism that determines whether shareholders get another bump or watch buybacks disappear first.

items.title: Bear of the Day: Amrize (AMRZ)
items.summary: Amrize (AMRZ) shares have been under considerable pressure as investors reassess the building-materials company's earnings trajectory, margins, and execution.

items.title: Bank Stocks Are Beaten Down. The Case for Buying Now.
items.summary: The outlook for bank stocks can’t get much worse, and that’s exactly why they look appealing.  The  ETF, home to investment banks and other lenders, has fallen 12% to $63 from an August record high of just over $71.  One reason for those worries is the Federal Reserve’s September interest-rate increase.

items.title: Bank of America (BAC) Stock Could Be 40% Below Fair Value On AI Spending Plans
items.summary: Bank of America has delivered a powerful share price run over the past few years, even though the stock has recently pulled back. That gap between a strong multi year return and a weaker recent stretch raises a simple question for you as an investor: Is the current valuation really backed by the returns the bank earns on its capital? Over the past 3 years, Bank of America has returned about 125.5%, which puts real pressure on the underlying return on capital to justify where the stock trades...

items.title: JPM vs. BAC: The Bank Built to Sustain Dividend Growth When Markets Turn
items.summary: JPMorgan and Bank of America both just raised their dividends and both stocks just slid, but only one has the capital cushion and crisis track record to keep paying through a downturn. Three measures separate a reliable retirement income stream from a fragile one.

items.title: Cramer Says Buy Apple Before New Phone Comes Out. Because Apple’s Duo Model Is, “Kind Of Astounding”
items.summary: Jim Cramer just called Apple's first foldable phone kind of astounding and told followers to buy shares before it ships, but a closer look at supply constraints, memory costs, and a one-time earnings boost raises real questions about whether the Duo can actually move the needle.
